expected_legal_description:
ALL THAT CERTAIN tract or parcel of land and premises situate, lying
and being in the Borough of HADDONFIELD, County of CAMDEN and State of
New Jersey more particularly described as follows:

BEGINNING at a point in the Southeasterly line of Kings Highway East,
as approved December 15, 1931 and adopted by Ordinance February 16, 1932
by Borough Commissioners, 171.76 feet Northeasterly from the Easterly
corner of Kings Highway East and Chestnut Street, said beginning point
being corner to remaining lands of George H. Heacock and Dorothy H.
Heacock;

THENCE:  Northeasterly along Southeasterly line of Kings Highway East,
84 feet to point corner to lands of Trustees of Baptist Church of
Haddonfield (formerly John Clement) and said point also being 97.23 feet
Southeasterly from westerly wall of 123 Kings Highway East; and

THENCE:  Southeasterly forming interior angle of 89 degrees 46 minutes
45 seconds with Kings Highway East and running along lands of said
Trustees of Baptist Church of Haddonfield 231.84 feet to point in line of
said Trustees of Baptist Church and corner to lands of the Borough of
Haddonfield;

THENCE:  Southwesterly along lands of Borough of Haddonfield and forming
an interior angle of 89 degrees 44 minutes 10 seconds with the last
course 83.05 feet to point corner of remaining lands of Estate of Charles
H. Hill; and also along line of remaining lands of George H. Heacock
and Dorothy H. Heacock aforesaid and forming an interior angle of 90
degrees 30 minutes with last course and also forming an interior angle of
89 degrees 59 minutes 5 seconds with Kings Highway East 83.15 feet to
Southeasterly line of Kings Highway East and place of beginning.

BEING KNOWN as Lot 6, Block 34, as shown on the tax map of the
Borough of Haddonfield.  (For information only)
